title: Spanish: Travel Phrases
description: For beginning travelers: complete phrases for greetings, transport, lodging, meals, shopping, and asking for help. English meanings explain when to use each phrase.

sources.name: Original educational explanations from general subject knowledge

cards.back: Latin-script reading: Buenos días. English: Good morning. Use: greeting someone in the morning.
cards.example: Greeting someone in the morning: "Buenos días."

cards.back: Latin-script reading: Buenas tardes. English: Good afternoon. Use: greeting someone in the afternoon.
cards.example: Greeting someone in the afternoon: "Buenas tardes."

cards.back: Latin-script reading: Buenas noches. English: Good evening or good night. Use: greeting someone at night or saying goodnight.
cards.example: Greeting someone at night or saying goodnight: "Buenas noches."

cards.back: Latin-script reading: Hola, ¿cómo está? English: Hello, how are you? Use: greeting someone politely.
cards.example: Greeting someone politely: "Hola, ¿cómo está?"

cards.back: Latin-script reading: Mucho gusto. English: Nice to meet you. Use: meeting someone for the first time.
cards.example: Meeting someone for the first time: "Mucho gusto."

cards.back: Latin-script reading: Me llamo Ana. English: My name is Ana. Use: introducing yourself with the example name Ana.
cards.example: Introducing yourself with the example name ana: "Me llamo Ana."

cards.back: Latin-script reading: ¿Cómo se llama usted? English: What is your name? Use: asking someone their name politely.
cards.example: Asking someone their name politely: "¿Cómo se llama usted?"

cards.back: Latin-script reading: Soy de Canadá. English: I am from Canada. Use: stating your country with Canada as the example.
cards.example: Stating your country with canada as the example: "Soy de Canadá."

cards.back: Latin-script reading: Hasta luego. English: See you later. Use: saying goodbye.
cards.example: Saying goodbye: "Hasta luego."

cards.back: Latin-script reading: Que tenga un buen día. English: Have a good day. Use: wishing someone well politely.
cards.example: Wishing someone well politely: "Que tenga un buen día."

cards.back: Latin-script reading: Por favor, ayúdeme. English: Please help me. Use: requesting help politely.
cards.example: Requesting help politely: "Por favor, ayúdeme."

cards.back: Latin-script reading: Muchas gracias. English: Thank you very much. Use: expressing gratitude.
cards.example: Expressing gratitude: "Muchas gracias."

cards.back: Latin-script reading: De nada. English: You are welcome. Use: responding to thanks.
cards.example: Responding to thanks: "De nada."

cards.back: Latin-script reading: Disculpe. English: Excuse me. Use: getting attention politely.
cards.example: Getting attention politely: "Disculpe."

cards.back: Latin-script reading: Lo siento. English: I am sorry. Use: apologizing.
cards.example: Apologizing: "Lo siento."

cards.back: Latin-script reading: No entiendo. English: I do not understand. Use: saying that you did not understand.
cards.example: Saying that you did not understand: "No entiendo."

cards.back: Latin-script reading: ¿Puede repetirlo, por favor? English: Can you repeat that, please? Use: asking someone to repeat.
cards.example: Asking someone to repeat: "¿Puede repetirlo, por favor?"

cards.back: Latin-script reading: ¿Puede hablar más despacio? English: Can you speak more slowly? Use: asking someone to slow down.
cards.example: Asking someone to slow down: "¿Puede hablar más despacio?"

cards.back: Latin-script reading: ¿Habla inglés? English: Do you speak English? Use: checking whether someone speaks English.
cards.example: Checking whether someone speaks english: "¿Habla inglés?"

cards.back: Latin-script reading: Hablo un poco de español. English: I speak a little Spanish. Use: describing your language ability.
cards.example: Describing your language ability: "Hablo un poco de español."

cards.back: Latin-script reading: ¿Cómo se dice esto en español? English: How do you say this in Spanish? Use: asking for a word or expression.
cards.example: Asking for a word or expression: "¿Cómo se dice esto en español?"

cards.back: Latin-script reading: ¿Puede escribirlo? English: Can you write it down? Use: requesting a written version.
cards.example: Requesting a written version: "¿Puede escribirlo?"

cards.back: Latin-script reading: ¿Dónde está el baño? English: Where is the bathroom? Use: looking for a restroom.
cards.example: Looking for a restroom: "¿Dónde está el baño?"

cards.back: Latin-script reading: ¿Dónde está la estación de tren? English: Where is the train station? Use: asking directions to a railway station.
cards.example: Asking directions to a railway station: "¿Dónde está la estación de tren?"

cards.back: Latin-script reading: ¿Dónde está la parada de autobús? English: Where is the bus stop? Use: locating a bus stop.
cards.example: Locating a bus stop: "¿Dónde está la parada de autobús?"

cards.back: Latin-script reading: ¿Cómo llego al centro? English: How do I get to the city center? Use: asking for directions downtown.
cards.example: Asking for directions downtown: "¿Cómo llego al centro?"

cards.back: Latin-script reading: ¿Está lejos de aquí? English: Is it far from here? Use: checking distance.
cards.example: Checking distance: "¿Está lejos de aquí?"

cards.back: Latin-script reading: ¿Se puede ir a pie? English: Can you walk there? Use: checking whether walking is possible.
cards.example: Checking whether walking is possible: "¿Se puede ir a pie?"

cards.back: Latin-script reading: ¿Es por aquí? English: Is it this way? Use: confirming a direction.
cards.example: Confirming a direction: "¿Es por aquí?"

cards.back: Latin-script reading: Estoy perdido. English: I am lost. Use: a male speaker asking for directions.
cards.example: A male speaker asking for directions: "Estoy perdido."

cards.back: Latin-script reading: Estoy perdida. English: I am lost. Use: a female speaker asking for directions.
cards.example: A female speaker asking for directions: "Estoy perdida."

cards.back: Latin-script reading: ¿Puede mostrarme en el mapa? English: Can you show me on the map? Use: asking for a location on a map.
cards.example: Asking for a location on a map: "¿Puede mostrarme en el mapa?"

cards.back: Latin-script reading: Quisiera un billete a Madrid. English: I would like a ticket to Madrid. Use: buying a ticket with Madrid as the example destination.
cards.example: Buying a ticket with madrid as the example destination: "Quisiera un billete a Madrid."

cards.back: Latin-script reading: Solo de ida, por favor. English: One way only, please. Use: specifying a one-way ticket.
cards.example: Specifying a one-way ticket: "Solo de ida, por favor."

cards.front: De ida y vuelta, por favor.
cards.back: Latin-script reading: De ida y vuelta, por favor. English: Round trip, please. Use: specifying a return ticket.
cards.example: Specifying a return ticket: "De ida y vuelta, por favor."

cards.back: Latin-script reading: ¿A qué hora sale el tren? English: What time does the train leave? Use: checking a train departure.
cards.example: Checking a train departure: "¿A qué hora sale el tren?"

cards.back: Latin-script reading: ¿De qué andén sale? English: Which platform does it leave from? Use: checking the departure platform.
cards.example: Checking the departure platform: "¿De qué andén sale?"

cards.back: Latin-script reading: ¿Este autobús va al aeropuerto? English: Does this bus go to the airport? Use: confirming a bus route.
cards.example: Confirming a bus route: "¿Este autobús va al aeropuerto?"

cards.back: Latin-script reading: ¿Dónde puedo comprar un billete? English: Where can I buy a ticket? Use: locating a ticket seller.
cards.example: Locating a ticket seller: "¿Dónde puedo comprar un billete?"

cards.back: Latin-script reading: ¿Tengo que hacer transbordo? English: Do I have to transfer? Use: checking whether a connection is necessary.
cards.example: Checking whether a connection is necessary: "¿Tengo que hacer transbordo?"

cards.back: Latin-script reading: ¿Está libre este asiento? English: Is this seat free? Use: asking before sitting down.
cards.example: Asking before sitting down: "¿Está libre este asiento?"

cards.back: Latin-script reading: Avíseme cuando lleguemos, por favor. English: Please let me know when we arrive. Use: asking to be told when to get off.
cards.example: Asking to be told when to get off: "Avíseme cuando lleguemos, por favor."

cards.back: Latin-script reading: Quisiera un taxi. English: I would like a taxi. Use: requesting a taxi.
cards.example: Requesting a taxi: "Quisiera un taxi."

cards.front: Lléveme a esta dirección, por favor.
cards.back: Latin-script reading: Lléveme a esta dirección, por favor. English: Take me to this address, please. Use: giving a taxi driver a destination.
cards.example: Giving a taxi driver a destination: "Lléveme a esta dirección, por favor."

cards.back: Latin-script reading: ¿Cuánto cuesta el viaje? English: How much does the trip cost? Use: asking about a fare.
cards.example: Asking about a fare: "¿Cuánto cuesta el viaje?"

cards.back: Latin-script reading: ¿Puede parar aquí? English: Can you stop here? Use: asking a driver to stop.
cards.example: Asking a driver to stop: "¿Puede parar aquí?"

cards.back: Latin-script reading: Tengo una reserva. English: I have a reservation. Use: checking in at a hotel or restaurant.
cards.example: Checking in at a hotel or restaurant: "Tengo una reserva."

cards.front: La reserva está a nombre de García.
cards.back: Latin-script reading: La reserva está a nombre de García. English: The reservation is under García. Use: giving the example booking surname García.
cards.example: Giving the example booking surname garcía: "La reserva está a nombre de García."

cards.back: Latin-script reading: ¿Tiene una habitación disponible? English: Do you have a room available? Use: asking about hotel availability.
cards.example: Asking about hotel availability: "¿Tiene una habitación disponible?"

cards.front: Quisiera una habitación para dos personas.
cards.back: Latin-script reading: Quisiera una habitación para dos personas. English: I would like a room for two people. Use: requesting accommodation for two.
cards.example: Requesting accommodation for two: "Quisiera una habitación para dos personas."

cards.back: Latin-script reading: ¿Cuánto cuesta por noche? English: How much is it per night? Use: asking a hotel rate.
cards.example: Asking a hotel rate: "¿Cuánto cuesta por noche?"

cards.back: Latin-script reading: ¿Está incluido el desayuno? English: Is breakfast included? Use: checking what a room rate includes.
cards.example: Checking what a room rate includes: "¿Está incluido el desayuno?"

cards.back: Latin-script reading: ¿A qué hora es la salida? English: What time is checkout? Use: checking hotel departure time.
cards.example: Checking hotel departure time: "¿A qué hora es la salida?"

cards.back: Latin-script reading: ¿Puedo dejar aquí mi equipaje? English: Can I leave my luggage here? Use: requesting luggage storage.
cards.example: Requesting luggage storage: "¿Puedo dejar aquí mi equipaje?"

cards.back: Latin-script reading: La llave no funciona. English: The key does not work. Use: reporting a room-access problem.
cards.example: Reporting a room-access problem: "La llave no funciona."

cards.back: Latin-script reading: No hay agua caliente. English: There is no hot water. Use: reporting a hotel problem.
cards.example: Reporting a hotel problem: "No hay agua caliente."

cards.back: Latin-script reading: ¿Puede darme otra toalla? English: Can you give me another towel? Use: requesting an extra towel.
cards.example: Requesting an extra towel: "¿Puede darme otra toalla?"

cards.back: Latin-script reading: ¿Cuál es la contraseña del wifi? English: What is the Wi-Fi password? Use: requesting network access.
cards.example: Requesting network access: "¿Cuál es la contraseña del wifi?"

cards.back: Latin-script reading: Quisiera quedarme una noche más. English: I would like to stay one more night. Use: extending a hotel stay.
cards.example: Extending a hotel stay: "Quisiera quedarme una noche más."

cards.back: Latin-script reading: Quisiera pagar la cuenta. English: I would like to settle the bill. Use: paying a hotel or restaurant bill.
cards.example: Paying a hotel or restaurant bill: "Quisiera pagar la cuenta."

cards.front: Una mesa para dos, por favor.
cards.back: Latin-script reading: Una mesa para dos, por favor. English: A table for two, please. Use: requesting restaurant seating.
cards.example: Requesting restaurant seating: "Una mesa para dos, por favor."

cards.back: Latin-script reading: ¿Tiene el menú en inglés? English: Do you have the menu in English? Use: asking for an English menu.
cards.example: Asking for an english menu: "¿Tiene el menú en inglés?"

cards.back: Latin-script reading: ¿Qué recomienda? English: What do you recommend? Use: asking for a recommendation.
cards.example: Asking for a recommendation: "¿Qué recomienda?"

cards.back: Latin-script reading: Quisiera pedir ahora. English: I would like to order now. Use: telling a server you are ready.
cards.example: Telling a server you are ready: "Quisiera pedir ahora."

cards.back: Latin-script reading: Quisiera esto, por favor. English: I would like this, please. Use: ordering while pointing to an item.
cards.example: Ordering while pointing to an item: "Quisiera esto, por favor."

cards.back: Latin-script reading: Sin carne, por favor. English: Without meat, please. Use: requesting a dish without meat.
cards.example: Requesting a dish without meat: "Sin carne, por favor."

cards.back: Latin-script reading: ¿Este plato lleva leche? English: Does this dish contain milk? Use: asking about an ingredient.
cards.example: Asking about an ingredient: "¿Este plato lleva leche?"

cards.back: Latin-script reading: No puedo comer cacahuetes. English: I cannot eat peanuts. Use: stating a food restriction without implying it covers all nuts.
cards.example: Stating a food restriction without implying it covers all nuts: "No puedo comer cacahuetes."

cards.back: Latin-script reading: ¿Tiene opciones vegetarianas? English: Do you have vegetarian options? Use: asking about meat-free dishes.
cards.example: Asking about meat-free dishes: "¿Tiene opciones vegetarianas?"

cards.back: Latin-script reading: Agua sin gas, por favor. English: Still water, please. Use: ordering noncarbonated water.
cards.example: Ordering noncarbonated water: "Agua sin gas, por favor."

cards.back: Latin-script reading: Agua con gas, por favor. English: Sparkling water, please. Use: ordering carbonated water.
cards.example: Ordering carbonated water: "Agua con gas, por favor."

cards.front: Un café con leche, por favor.
cards.back: Latin-script reading: Un café con leche, por favor. English: A coffee with milk, please. Use: ordering coffee with milk.
cards.example: Ordering coffee with milk: "Un café con leche, por favor."

cards.back: Latin-script reading: Sin azúcar, por favor. English: Without sugar, please. Use: requesting no sugar.
cards.example: Requesting no sugar: "Sin azúcar, por favor."

cards.back: Latin-script reading: La cuenta, por favor. English: The bill, please. Use: asking for the restaurant bill.
cards.example: Asking for the restaurant bill: "La cuenta, por favor."

cards.back: Latin-script reading: ¿Está incluido el servicio? English: Is service included? Use: checking the service charge.
cards.example: Checking the service charge: "¿Está incluido el servicio?"

cards.back: Latin-script reading: ¿Podemos pagar por separado? English: Can we pay separately? Use: asking to split payments.
cards.example: Asking to split payments: "¿Podemos pagar por separado?"

cards.back: Latin-script reading: Para llevar, por favor. English: To go, please. Use: ordering takeaway food.
cards.example: Ordering takeaway food: "Para llevar, por favor."

cards.back: Latin-script reading: Estaba muy rico. English: It was delicious. Use: complimenting a meal.
cards.example: Complimenting a meal: "Estaba muy rico."

cards.back: Latin-script reading: ¿Cuánto cuesta esto? English: How much does this cost? Use: asking an item price.
cards.example: Asking an item price: "¿Cuánto cuesta esto?"

cards.back: Latin-script reading: Solo estoy mirando. English: I am just looking. Use: responding to a shop assistant.
cards.example: Responding to a shop assistant: "Solo estoy mirando."

cards.back: Latin-script reading: ¿Tiene otra talla? English: Do you have another size? Use: asking about clothing sizes.
cards.example: Asking about clothing sizes: "¿Tiene otra talla?"

cards.back: Latin-script reading: ¿Puedo probármelo? English: Can I try it on? Use: asking to try on a masculine-noun item such as a coat.
cards.example: Asking to try on a masculine-noun item such as a coat: "¿Puedo probármelo?"

cards.back: Latin-script reading: Me queda demasiado grande. English: It is too big for me. Use: describing the fit of clothing.
cards.example: Describing the fit of clothing: "Me queda demasiado grande."

cards.back: Latin-script reading: ¿Tiene otro color? English: Do you have another color? Use: asking about a different color.
cards.example: Asking about a different color: "¿Tiene otro color?"

cards.back: Latin-script reading: Me lo llevo. English: I will take it. Use: deciding to buy a masculine-noun item.
cards.example: Deciding to buy a masculine-noun item: "Me lo llevo."

cards.back: Latin-script reading: ¿Puedo pagar con tarjeta? English: Can I pay by card? Use: checking payment options.
cards.example: Checking payment options: "¿Puedo pagar con tarjeta?"

cards.back: Latin-script reading: ¿Acepta efectivo? English: Do you accept cash? Use: checking whether cash is accepted.
cards.example: Checking whether cash is accepted: "¿Acepta efectivo?"

cards.back: Latin-script reading: Necesito un recibo. English: I need a receipt. Use: requesting proof of purchase.
cards.example: Requesting proof of purchase: "Necesito un recibo."

cards.back: Latin-script reading: ¿Dónde hay un cajero automático? English: Where is there an ATM? Use: looking for a cash machine.
cards.example: Looking for a cash machine: "¿Dónde hay un cajero automático?"

cards.back: Latin-script reading: ¿A qué hora abre? English: What time does it open? Use: asking opening time.
cards.example: Asking opening time: "¿A qué hora abre?"

cards.back: Latin-script reading: ¿A qué hora cierra? English: What time does it close? Use: asking closing time.
cards.example: Asking closing time: "¿A qué hora cierra?"

cards.back: Latin-script reading: Quisiera dos entradas. English: I would like two admission tickets. Use: buying tickets for an attraction.
cards.example: Buying tickets for an attraction: "Quisiera dos entradas."

cards.back: Latin-script reading: ¿Se pueden hacer fotos? English: Are photos allowed? Use: checking photography permission.
cards.example: Checking photography permission: "¿Se pueden hacer fotos?"

cards.back: Latin-script reading: He perdido mi pasaporte. English: I have lost my passport. Use: reporting a missing travel document.
cards.example: Reporting a missing travel document: "He perdido mi pasaporte."

cards.back: Latin-script reading: Necesito un médico. English: I need a doctor. Use: requesting medical help.
cards.example: Requesting medical help: "Necesito un médico."

cards.front: Llame a una ambulancia, por favor.
cards.back: Latin-script reading: Llame a una ambulancia, por favor. English: Call an ambulance, please. Use: asking someone to summon urgent medical help.
cards.example: Asking someone to summon urgent medical help: "Llame a una ambulancia, por favor."

cards.back: Latin-script reading: ¿Dónde está la farmacia? English: Where is the pharmacy? Use: locating a pharmacy.
cards.example: Locating a pharmacy: "¿Dónde está la farmacia?"

cards.back: Latin-script reading: No me siento bien. English: I do not feel well. Use: telling someone you feel unwell.
cards.example: Telling someone you feel unwell: "No me siento bien."

cards.back: Latin-script reading: Necesito llamar a mi familia. English: I need to call my family. Use: requesting help contacting family.
cards.example: Requesting help contacting family: "Necesito llamar a mi familia."

cards.back: Latin-script reading: ¿Puede ayudarme a encontrar mi hotel? English: Can you help me find my hotel? Use: asking for help locating your accommodation.
cards.example: Asking for help locating your accommodation: "¿Puede ayudarme a encontrar mi hotel?"
